summary: There are no shadows on text displayed within the action bar
description:
## The Bug:

There are no shadows on text displayed within the action bar.

This is an issue because the text can be quite difficult to read, so having a shadow displayed on all text within the action bar would resolve this problem.

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Display some text on the action bar and look at it closely.

 - 

/title @a actionbar {"text":"MC-72687","color":"white"}

 - Take note as to whether or not there are any shadows on text displayed within the action bar.

## Observed Behavior:

There are no shadows on text displayed within the action bar.

## Expected Behavior:

There would be shadows on text displayed within the action bar.

## Code Analysis:

Code analysis by haykam can be found in this comment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
3. Open the in-game chat.
4. Enter and execute `/title @a actionbar {"text":"MC-72687","color":"white"}`.
5. Observe the text displayed in the action bar and note that it has no shadow.
Observed Behavior:
Text rendered in the action bar does not receive a text shadow. For example, the white text displayed by:

```mcfunction
/title @a actionbar {"text":"MC-72687","color":"white"}
```

appears without the dark offset outline/shadow used to improve text contrast, which can make it difficult to read against certain backgrounds.
Expected Behavior: Text displayed in the action bar should include a visible shadow behind the characters, including the white text shown by the provided command. The shadow should be applied consistently across action bar text so that it is easier to distinguish from the game background and remains readable during normal gameplay.
